about: Replay of the release planner (lib/gateScope.mjs) against 224 fork fix commits and 34 probes. Each entry names the paths a change touched and the tests that must run for it. `expect` is what the planner answers today: hit when the plan runs every mustRun test, miss when it does not. A miss is a known gap; it carries its class. The test goes red when any answer changes, so a fixed gap must be flipped to hit and a new gap must be seen. Probes with no mustRun pin the plan shape (check id to mode). No git history is needed.
source: Verifier 2 backtest, qa/hbots-ci-ideas/backtest/cases.json, planner commit e311aa7c7d6b, trimmed. Cases whose must-run test is gone from the tree are counted in `dropped`.
